dividend_probe.scope: One payment on a deep copy of the completed market; original run and its RNG are untouched
dividend_probe.payment_timing: Day-t intrinsic values, after day-t trading; no separate record, ex-dividend or payment dates
dividend_probe.economic_interpretation: Payment explicitly injects external cash and has no mechanical ex-dividend price/value reduction. P-change plus D is the accounting total return of this model, but correct cum/ex-dividend valuation and possible economic double counting remain unresolved; absence of an explicit price drop alone does not prove double counting.

target.role: Previously used training target, not untouched evaluation data. 29 French SIC industry value-weighted portfolios, 6539 daily observations, 2000-01-03 through 2025-12-31; original raw data and validation/test targets are not re-read.

mechanical.cash_error_measure: relative to expected cash; absolute if expected cash is zero
mechanical.share_error_measure: daily maximum absolute error across all assets

empirical_calibration.reason: This validator does not evaluate held-out empirical targets.

operator_fixture.scope: Hand-calculated two-day, three-company accounting fixture; not another market simulation

ex_dividend_probe.scope: One payment on a deep copy of the completed market; original run and its RNG are untouched
ex_dividend_probe.payment_timing: Day-t intrinsic values, after day-t trading; no separate record, ex-dividend or payment dates
ex_dividend_probe.economic_interpretation: Payment explicitly injects external cash and has no mechanical ex-dividend price/value reduction. P-change plus D is the accounting total return of this model, but correct cum/ex-dividend valuation and possible economic double counting remain unresolved; absence of an explicit price drop alone does not prove double counting.

limitations: Anonymous 6-7-company synthetic baskets have no SIC exposure structure, economic sector shocks or matching sector membership; equal basket counts do not make these French industries.
The old target already fitted defaults. Differences in old bootstrap-SE units are descriptive, not new z-tests or acceptance gates; one reused development seed is not independent validation.
No firm entry, exit, delisting, splits or dynamic shares; model survivorship is structural. French portfolios have real constituent sizes and annual SIC reclassification.

Market dividends are external daily transfers with no explicit ex-dividend price or intrinsic-value reduction. Accounting total-return construction does not solve the economic payout/valuation definition.
Neither target mapping nor parameters selected, no raw French data or sealed holdout read, no formal seeds run.
